title: allium cepa subsp. fistulosum
intro: Allium cepa subsp. fistulosum, commonly known as Welsh onion or Japanese bunching onion, is a plant species belonging to the Allium genus, characterized by its edible bulbs and leaves. The health benefits of Welsh onion include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable addition to a healthy diet. The therapeutic actions of Welsh onion include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Welsh onion include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sulfur compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
